therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: protein degradation pathway disruption leading to cancer cell apoptosis

results.effect_size: Part A (PS-341 alone): 1/24 partial response, 0/24 complete response; Part B (PS-341 + EPOCH): 7/44 partial response, 8/44 complete response
subgroup_findings: PS-341 combination with EPOCH showed superior response rates compared to PS-341 alone
safety_signals: Anemia requiring red blood cell transfusions
results.dose_information: PS-341: 1.3 mg/m² IV days 1, 4, 8, 11 every 3 weeks; EPOCH: Etoposide 50 mg/m²/day CIV days 1-4, Doxorubicin 10 mg/m²/day CIV days 1-4, Vincristine 0.4 mg/m²/day CIV days 1-4, Cyclophosphamide 750 mg/m² IV day 5, Prednisone 60 mg/m² PO BID days 1-5

context.comparator: PS-341 alone vs PS-341 plus EPOCH chemotherapy
context.duration: 18 weeks treatment assessment, 43 months safety follow-up
